Requirement: To realize Deductive Reasoning [R.Deductive-Reasoning] integrates general logical rules (input: [U.PPC-SPL] Output Semantics "spatial rule structure representation" and [U.PPC-IPL] Output Semantics "logical argument structure") with specific problem instances (input: [U.HPC] Output Semantics "individual relational encoding" and [U.mPFC] Output Semantics "task context and goal state") to derive logically valid conclusions (output: integrated inference results sent to [U.rACC] [U.PMC] [U.DLPFC]). This process references and updates working memory (input/output: [U.DLPFC] Output Semantics "working memory contents") verifies validity through error monitoring (input/output: [U.dACC] Output Semantics "error and conflict detection signal") and adjusts cognitive control state (input/output: [U.MDT] Output Semantics "integrated cognitive control signal"). Emotional context (input: [U.BLA] Output Semantics "emotional salience") is also integrated.
Requirement realization by interface: Following Interface [U.HPC] provides individual relational encoding (e.g. episodic memories such as "A beat B in trial 1" "B beat C in trial 2") and [U.mPFC] provides task context and goal state ("infer transitive relations" as task requirement). These are integrated in [U.RLPFC-Medial] (contained in [R.Deductive-Reasoning]) to construct contextualized relational representation ("A is stronger than B" "B is stronger than C"). Simultaneously [U.PPC-SPL] provides spatial rule structure representation (transitivity rule format) [U.PPC-IPL] provides logical argument structure (premise-conclusion relation) [U.DLPFC] provides working memory contents (intermediate information) [U.MDT] provides cognitive control signal and [U.dACC] provides error monitoring signal. All these are integrated in [U.RLPFC-Lateral] (contained in [R.Deductive-Reasoning]). Contextualized relations from [U.RLPFC-Medial] and rule structures from [U.PPC-SPL] [U.PPC-IPL] are integrated while referencing [U.DLPFC] working memory to execute transitive inference ("A is stronger than C"). Validity is verified through error signals from [U.dACC]. Integrated inference result is output to [U.DLPFC] as working memory update to [U.dACC] as monitoring information to [U.rACC] for emotional evaluation and to [U.PMC] for action selection. Rule representation updates are fed back to [U.PPC-SPL] [U.PPC-IPL] and cognitive control state to [U.MDT]. Thus the deductive reasoning function required by Requirement is realized through all input/output UCs and their Output Semantics defined in Interface.
Capability: Receives multiple individual cases (individual cases) general rules (general rules) and task demand (task demand) integrates them to generate logical conclusion (logical conclusion) and action guidance (action guidance). This Capability is applicable to arbitrary deductive reasoning tasks independent of specific domains (mathematical reasoning legal judgment everyday problem solving etc.). Computationally realized as stepwise process: (1) relational extraction from episodic memory (2) information structuring based on context (3) rule selection (4) novel relation derivation through relational integration (5) validity verification (6) result output. Neuroscientific basis: Multiple meta-analyses (Monti et al. 2007; Prado et al. 2011) demonstrated that deductive reasoning is realized by frontoparietal network centered on left RLPFC (BA10). Wendelken et al. (2008) Bludau et al. (2014) showed that relational integration is executed in RLPFC-Lateral and episodic memory integration in RLPFC-Medial. Computational basis: Deductive reasoning is formulated in relational complexity theory (Halford et al. 1998) as ability to process multiple relations simultaneously. Transitive inference (A>B B>C → A>C) is tertiary relation processing that integrates two binary relations.
Mechanism: [R.Deductive-Reasoning] is realized through coordination of two core neural circuits ([U.RLPFC-Medial] [U.RLPFC-Lateral]). First in hippocampal-PFC circuit individual episodic memories from [U.HPC] are sent to [U.RLPFC-Medial] and selectively activated by task context from [U.mPFC]. In Default Mode Network (to which [U.RLPFC-Medial] belongs) individual episodes are abstracted from temporal and spatial context and relational structure is extracted. This contextualized relational representation is sent to [U.RLPFC-Lateral]. Next through dynamic binding mechanism in frontoparietal network [U.RLPFC-Lateral] integrates contextualized premises from [U.RLPFC-Medial] rule structures from [U.PPC-SPL] and [U.PPC-IPL] and working memory contents from [U.DLPFC]. This integration is dynamic binding process accompanied by increased phase synchrony and strengthened functional connectivity (Duncan et al. 2020). [U.RLPFC-Lateral] functions as top-down effective connectivity source integrating distributed representations in hierarchical representation space. Consistency of integration is verified by error monitoring signals from [U.dACC]. Integrated inference result is output in parallel to [U.DLPFC] as working memory update to [U.dACC] as monitoring information to [U.rACC] for emotional evaluation and to [U.PMC] for action selection. Global cognitive control state is adjusted through bidirectional connection with [U.MDT]. Thus deductive reasoning is realized through hierarchical coordination of Default Mode Network and Executive Control Network.
